plan.width: 64 for prompts of up to 256 tokens, 256 above (LanguageStepContract.defaultPrefillChunk); a requested width and the export bound win
plan.capacity: a bucketed request's cache is allocated for its prefill tokens rounded up to 256 rows (at least the initial capacity) before the prefill (LanguageCachePlan.requestCapacity); decoding grows it in 256-row steps as before
plan.shortPrompts: prompts of up to 256 tokens: the same width (64) and capacity (256) as before

before: an origin/main build (bfbf814) with the branch's LanguagePrefillChunkSweepTests.swift, which adds the longer-prompt options; same bundles

planGate.gate: 449-token prompt, default plan (width 256 above 256 prompt tokens, last chunk stepping back 63 rows, cache sized for the prompt before the prefill) against three plans; last-row logits cosine >= 0.9999 with equal argmax for each. Rule step-back (against one whole-prompt chunk, the exactness claim): identical 32-token greedy. Rule plan-rounding (against 1-token steps and against the 0.0.2 width of 64, other kernel shapes): identical greedy, or a first divergence where the two plans' tokens are the upstream reference's top two at that row, its top-1 minus top-2 probability < 0.1 (the parity threshold), and the two plans' teacher-forced rows have cosine >= 0.99999 on every row up to and including it (acceptedAtNearTie, margin and source recorded); any other divergence fails. Qwen3-VL image prompts (a long and a short question about one image, and two images) under the default plan, one 512-token-wide plan and 1-token steps: identical greedy, no near-tie allowance
